title: Countable Fan Tightness and Selection Games in Group-Valued Function Spaces
summary: Game-theoretic characterizations of selection principles provide a powerful framework for analyzing covering properties through strategic interactions. For a Tychonoff space $X$ and a non-trivial metrizable arc-connected topological group $G$, we prove that Player~II has a winning strategy in the $Ω$-Menger game on $X$ if and only if Player~II has a winning strategy in the countable fan tightness game on $C_p(X, G)$ at the identity function.
